units.source_text: 从盥洗间折回来的大竹七段也说：“您歇歇吧，

en.t: Otake 7-dan, who had come back from the washroom, also said, "Please take a rest,

units.source_text: 请随便……让我一个人思考，

en.t: do as you like... let me think alone,

units.source_text: 把棋子封起来……决不同别人商量。”

en.t: seal up the stones... I absolutely will not consult with anyone else."
